core_obligations: At a point x, use local Noetherianness to list the finitely many irreducible components through x with generic points eta_i, and reducedness to identify the local ring at eta_i with the residue field (proof lines 4570-4578).

Use perfection of k to conclude that kappa(eta_i) is separably generated over k, so its module of differentials is free of rank the transcendence degree, and deduce dim_{eta_i}(X_i) equals that rank (proof lines 4579-4585).

Compare ranks: since x lies on every X_i, local freeness of Omega_{X/k} gives rank_x = rank_{eta_i} = dim(X_i), whence dim_x(X) = rank_x(Omega_{X/k}), and the algebra criterion gives smoothness of X over k at x (proof lines 4586-4593).
proof_roadmap: List the components through x and identify local rings at their generic points (proof lines 4570-4578).
Compute the rank of the differentials at the generic points via separable generation (proof lines 4579-4585).
Compare ranks and apply the smoothness criterion (proof lines 4586-4593).
difficulty_reason: For a scheme X over a field k which is locally of finite type, has locally free differentials, is reduced, and has perfect base field, the lemma concludes that X to Spec(k) is smooth (statement lines 4556-4567). The proof works at an arbitrary point x: local Noetherianness gives finitely many irreducible components through x with generic points eta_i, reducedness identifies the local ring at each eta_i with the residue field, and perfection of k makes that finitely generated field extension separably generated, so its module of differentials is free of rank equal to the transcendence degree (proof lines 4570-4583). Comparing ranks along the components through x and using the dimension formula for the fibre at a point yields dim_x(X) = rank_x(Omega_{X/k}), which by the algebra criterion for smoothness over a field is exactly smoothness at x (proof lines 4584-4593). The claim is H2: five cited inputs assembled in the correct order, with the rank comparison across components through x as the step that makes the argument work at a non-generic point.
